+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# charting-decisions.bats: the /chart command, the charting-decisions skill frontmatter, the map
+# template and the shell steps the skill calls (chart-guard.sh, chart-ticket.sh,
+# chart-unblock-probe.sh). SDD D-4.1 to D-4.5, D-4.10 to D-4.12.
+#
+# Hermetic: .claude/scripts is copied into a fresh git repo per file, so the decision-ledger
+# writer sees no live run state, no autonomous PRD and no main checkout. beads is a PATH stub
+# (tests/fixtures/charting/br-stub.sh); the ledger is a --ledger fixture outside the tree.
+
+setup_file() {
+    export REAL_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+    export H="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/proj"
+    mkdir -p "$H/.claude"
+    cp -R "$REAL_ROOT/.claude/scripts" "$H/.claude/scripts"
+    git -C "$H" init -q
+    git -C "$H" -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    mkdir -p "$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin"
+    cp "$REAL_ROOT/tests/fixtures/charting/br-stub.sh" "$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin/br"
+    chmod +x "$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin/br"
+}
+
+setup() {
+    unset LOA_UNATTENDED LOA_FLATLINE_MODE CI GITHUB_ACTIONS LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT BR_FAIL_ON
+    rm -rf "$H/grimoires" "$H/.run" "$H/.beads"
+    mkdir -p "$H/grimoires/loa/maps" "$H/grimoires/loa/research" "$H/grimoires/loa/context" "$H/.beads"
+    export BR_STATE="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/br-state.json" BR_LOG="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/br.log"
+    echo '[]' > "$BR_STATE"; : > "$BR_LOG"
+    export LEDGER="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/decisions.yaml"
+    printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n' > "$LEDGER"
+    export PATH="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/bin:$PATH"
+    CT="$H/.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh"
+    GUARD="$H/.claude/scripts/chart-guard.sh"
+    SKILL="$REAL_ROOT/.claude/skills/charting-decisions/SKILL.md"
+    TEMPLATE="$REAL_ROOT/.claude/skills/charting-decisions/resources/templates/map.md"
+}
+
+ct() { "$CT" "$@" --root "$H" --ledger "$LEDGER"; }
+rows() { yq -o=json -I0 '.decisions' "$LEDGER"; }
+bead() { jq -c --arg id "$1" '.[] | select(.id == $id)' "$BR_STATE"; }
+h2s() { grep -E '^## ' "$1" | tr '\n' '|'; }
+# A PATH with no br on it (keeps jq, yq, git).
+path_without_br() {
+    local out="" d IFS=:
+    for d in $PATH; do [[ -x "$d/br" ]] && continue; out="${out:+$out:}$d"; done
+    printf '%s' "$out"
+}
+mkmap() {
+    ct epic --map eval-workers --title "Self-hosted eval workers" --destination "Every eval runs on workers the project operates."
+}
+mktickets() {
+    ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket isolation --label grilling --question "Which isolation do workers use?" --body "Decides the sandbox boundary."
+    ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket cost --label research --question "What is the cost ceiling per run?" --body "Decides the budget alarm."
+    ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket bash32 --label unblock --unblocks isolation --question "Does the runner build on bash 3.2?" --body "Settles macOS workers."
+}
+resolve_one() { # $1 bead id
+    ct resolve --map eval-workers --bead "$1" --name "Worker isolation" --line "containers per run" \
+        --decision "Run each eval in its own container" --rationale "simplest boundary" \
+        --alternative-json '{"option":"shared VM","rejected_because":"cross-run leakage"}' --evidence "session round 3"
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Command, skill frontmatter, template
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "CD-1 the skill passes validate-skill-capabilities.sh and stays under budget" {
+    run bash "$REAL_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities.sh" --skill charting-decisions
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"PASS"* ]]
+    [ "$(wc -c < "$SKILL")" -le 16384 ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-2 frontmatter: role planning, no agent key, no operator-only ledger operation" {
+    fm="$(awk 'NR==1 && /^---$/ {f=1; next} f && /^---$/ {exit} f' "$SKILL")"
+    [[ "$fm" == *"role: planning"* ]]
+    ! grep -qE '^agent:' <<< "$fm"
+    tools="$(grep -E '^allowed-tools:' <<< "$fm")"
+    [[ "$tools" == *"Bash(.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh new *)"* ]]
+    [[ "$tools" == *"Bash(.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh decide *)"* ]]
+    [[ "$tools" == *"Bash(.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh list *)"* ]]
+    [[ "$tools" == *"Bash(.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh context)"* ]]
+    [[ "$tools" == *"Bash(br *)"* ]]
+    ! grep -qE 'confirm|supersede|--clear|import|dec-write-lib\.sh \*' <<< "$tools"
+    [[ "$fm" == *"deny_raw_shell: true"* ]]
+    [[ "$fm" == *"web_access: false"* ]]
+    # the helpers the skill may run never reach an operator-only operation either
+    ! grep -nE '(dw|"\$DW") (confirm|supersede|import)|--clear' "$REAL_ROOT"/.claude/scripts/chart-{ticket,guard,frontier,unblock-probe}.sh
+}
+
+@test "CD-3 /chart command: truename with one optional target, the skill as agent, br pre-flight" {
+    f="$REAL_ROOT/.claude/commands/chart.md"
+    grep -q '^agent: "charting-decisions"' "$f"
+    grep -q '^agent_path: "skills/charting-decisions/"' "$f"
+    grep -q 'command: "br --version"' "$f"
+    [ "$(grep -c '^  - name: ' "$f")" -eq 1 ]
+    grep -q '^  - name: "target"' "$f"
+    ! grep -q 'disable-model-invocation' "$f"
+}
+
+@test "CD-4 map template: header lines and exactly the four H2 sections in order, no other" {
+    grep -q '^\*\*Slug\*\*: ' "$TEMPLATE"
+    grep -q '^\*\*Status\*\*: charting$' "$TEMPLATE"
+    grep -q '^\*\*Epic\*\*: ' "$TEMPLATE"
+    [ "$(h2s "$TEMPLATE")" = "## Destination|## Decisions so far|## Not yet specified|## Out of scope|" ]
+    awk '/^## Decisions so far/ {f=1; next} /^## / {f=0} f && /^- /' "$TEMPLATE" | while read -r l; do
+        [[ "$l" =~ DEC-[0-9]{4} ]]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "CD-5 the skill states the no-fog stop message before any write step" {
+    grep -qF 'This fits one cycle: run `/plan` (or `/bug` for a defect).' "$SKILL"
+    stop="$(grep -nF 'No-fog stop' "$SKILL" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)"
+    epic="$(grep -nF 'CT epic --map' "$SKILL" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)"
+    [ "$stop" -lt "$epic" ]
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Unattended refusal (chart-guard.sh)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "CD-6 chart-guard refuses under LOA_UNATTENDED=1 with the interactive-only message" {
+    LOA_UNATTENDED=1 run "$GUARD"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"/chart is interactive: a map whose rounds the agent answered is not a map. Run it with the operator present."* ]]
+    [ -z "$(ls -A "$H/grimoires/loa/maps")" ]
+    [ ! -s "$BR_LOG" ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-7 chart-guard passes interactively with br present" {
+    run "$GUARD"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$output" = "interactive" ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-8 chart-guard refuses when br is missing" {
+    PATH="$(path_without_br)" run "$GUARD"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"br (beads_rust) is not on PATH"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "CD-9 chart-guard --close-consumed is the one unattended pass" {
+    LOA_UNATTENDED=1 run "$GUARD" --close-consumed
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$output" = "unattended" ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-10 chart-guard refuses an autonomous PRD Status line" {
+    printf '# PRD\n\n**Status:** Draft, autonomous run\n' > "$H/grimoires/loa/prd.md"
+    run "$GUARD" --root "$H"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Chart: epic, tickets, edges (write order, idempotency, dry run)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "CD-11 dry run walks a fixture map without touching beads, the ledger or the doc" {
+    before="$(cat "$LEDGER")"
+    run "$CT" epic --map eval-workers --title "T" --destination "D." --root "$H" --ledger "$LEDGER" --dry-run
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *'"dry_run":true'* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"--labels map"* || "$(cat "$BR_LOG")" == *"--labels map"* ]]
+    [ ! -f "$H/grimoires/loa/maps/eval-workers.md" ]
+    mkmap
+    : > "$BR_LOG"; cp "$BR_STATE" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/state.before"
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket isolation --label grilling --question "Q?" --body "B." --dry-run
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"would:"*"new --status open --phase charting"*"map:eval-workers/isolation"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *'"issue_type":"question"'* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *'"labels":["decision:grilling"]'* ]]
+    grep -q -- '--dry-run' "$BR_LOG"
+    run ct edge --bead bd-a --needs bd-b --dry-run
+    [[ "$output" == "would: br dep add bd-a bd-b" ]]
+    [ "$(cat "$LEDGER")" = "$before" ]
+    cmp -s "$BR_STATE" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/state.before"
+}
+
+@test "CD-12 a fixture map: epic, question children with one decision label, open rows, edges" {
+    run mkmap
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    epic="$output"
+    doc="$H/grimoires/loa/maps/eval-workers.md"
+    grep -q '^\*\*Status\*\*: charting$' "$doc"
+    grep -q "^\*\*Epic\*\*: ${epic}$" "$doc"
+    [ "$(h2s "$doc")" = "$(h2s "$TEMPLATE")" ]
+    [ "$(bead "$epic" | jq -r '.issue_type + " " + (.labels | join(","))')" = "epic map" ]
+    mktickets
+    [ "$(rows | jq 'length')" -eq 3 ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq -r '[.[] | .status] | unique | join(",")')" = "open" ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq -r '[.[].source] | join(" ")')" = "map:eval-workers/isolation map:eval-workers/cost map:eval-workers/bash32" ]
+    [ "$(jq '[.[] | select(.issue_type == "question")] | length' "$BR_STATE")" -eq 3 ]
+    jq -e --arg e "$epic" 'all(.[] | select(.issue_type == "question"); .parent == $e and ([.labels[] | select(startswith("decision:"))] | length) == 1 and ([.labels[] | select(startswith("sprint:"))] | length) == 0)' "$BR_STATE"
+    for r in $(rows | jq -r '.[].id'); do
+        [ "$(jq --arg r "$r" '[.[] | select(.external_ref == $r)] | length' "$BR_STATE")" -eq 1 ]
+    done
+    jq -e '.[] | select(.title | startswith("Does the runner")) | .description | contains("Unblocks: isolation")' "$BR_STATE"
+    iso="$(jq -r '.[] | select(.external_ref != null and (.title | startswith("Which"))) | .id' "$BR_STATE")"
+    b32="$(jq -r '.[] | select(.title | startswith("Does")) | .id' "$BR_STATE")"
+    ct edge --bead "$iso" --needs "$b32"
+    ct edge --bead "$b32" --none
+    [ "$(bead "$iso" | jq -r '.deps | join(",")')" = "$b32" ]
+    bead "$b32" | jq -e '.labels | index("deps:none")'
+}
+
+@test "CD-13 write order: a failed bead create leaves the open row; the re-run reuses it" {
+    mkmap
+    BR_FAIL_ON=create run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket isolation --label grilling --question "Q?" --body "B."
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq 'length')" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq -r '.[0].status')" = "open" ]
+    [ "$(jq '[.[] | select(.issue_type == "question")] | length' "$BR_STATE")" -eq 0 ]
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket isolation --label grilling --question "Q?" --body "B."
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq 'length')" -eq 1 ]
+    row="$(rows | jq -r '.[0].id')"
+    [[ "$output" == "isolation	${row}	"* ]]
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket isolation --label grilling --question "Q?" --body "B."
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq 'length')" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq '[.[] | select(.issue_type == "question")] | length' "$BR_STATE")" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-14 a failed row write creates no bead" {
+    mkmap
+    chmod a-w "$LEDGER"; chmod a-w "$(dirname "$LEDGER")"
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket isolation --label grilling --question "Q?" --body "B."
+    chmod u+w "$(dirname "$LEDGER")" "$LEDGER"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq '[.[] | select(.issue_type == "question")] | length' "$BR_STATE")" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-15 labels: only the four decision types; unblock names what it unblocks" {
+    mkmap
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket a --label task --question "Q?" --body "B."
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket a --label unblock --question "Q?" --body "B."
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"--unblocks"* ]]
+    [ "$(rows | jq 'length')" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-16 free text with a URL is refused" {
+    mkmap
+    run ct ticket --map eval-workers --ticket a --label grilling --question "See https://example.com?" --body "B."
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(rows | jq 'length')" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Work: claim, resolve, rule-out
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "CD-17 resolving a ticket: decide with evidence, comment, close, one Decisions so far line" {
+    mkmap; mktickets
+    iso="$(jq -r '.[] | select(.title | startswith("Which")) | .id' "$BR_STATE")"
+    ct claim --bead "$iso"
+    [ "$(bead "$iso" | jq -r .status)" = "in_progress" ]
+    run resolve_one "$iso"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    row="$(bead "$iso" | jq -r .external_ref)"
+    r="$(rows | jq -c --arg r "$row" '.[] | select(.id == $r)')"
+    [ "$(jq -r .status <<< "$r")" = "proposed" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r .decision <<< "$r")" = "Run each eval in its own container" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.decided_by' <<< "$r")" = "null" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.transitions[-1].evidence' <<< "$r")" = "session round 3" ]
+    [ "$(bead "$iso" | jq -r .status)" = "closed" ]
+    [ "$(bead "$iso" | jq -r .close_reason)" = "$row" ]
+    bead "$iso" | jq -e --arg r "$row" '.comments[0] | startswith("Proposed: Run each eval") and contains("(" + $r + ")")'
+    doc="$H/grimoires/loa/maps/eval-workers.md"
+    grep -qxF -- "- Worker isolation (${row}, ${iso}): containers per run" "$doc"
+    ! grep -q '_None yet._' "$doc"
+    [ "$(h2s "$doc")" = "$(h2s "$TEMPLATE")" ]
+    run resolve_one "$iso"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$(grep -c "(${row}, " "$doc")" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "CD-18 resolve refuses a bead that is not a ticket of this map" {

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/charting-lint.bats: decision tickets stay off the build path
+# (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-4.7, D-4.8).
+#
+#   create-sprint-task.sh refuses type question and a map epic before any bead
+#   exists; get-ready-work.sh drops question beads whatever their labels and
+#   keeps every other type; the implement path selects work through it;
+#   validate-artifact.sh --type sprint flags a question bead with a sprint:
+#   label or under a sprint epic; --type map checks the epic's children.
+#
+# Every br call goes to a PATH stub that answers from fixture files and logs
+# its argv, so no beads database is touched.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    CREATE_TASK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/create-sprint-task.sh"
+    GET_READY="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/get-ready-work.sh"
+    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
+
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
+    export BR_FIX="$WORK/fix" BR_LOG="$WORK/br.log"
+    mkdir -p "$WORK/bin" "$BR_FIX" "$WORK/cwd"
+    : > "$BR_LOG"
+    cat > "$WORK/bin/br" <<'STUB'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# br stub: answers from $BR_FIX, logs argv to $BR_LOG.
+printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$BR_LOG"
+sub="${1:-}"; shift || true
+case "$sub" in
+  show)
+    f="$BR_FIX/show-$1.json"
+    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then cat "$f"; else echo '{"error":"not found"}' >&2; exit 1; fi ;;
+  create) echo "CREATE $*" >> "$BR_LOG"; echo '{"id":"bd-new1"}' ;;
+  label) [[ "${1:-}" == list ]] && cat "$BR_FIX/labels-${2:-x}.txt" 2>/dev/null; exit 0 ;;
+  dep) exit 0 ;;
+  ready) cat "$BR_FIX/ready.json" ;;
+  list)
+    type=all
+    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do [[ "$1" == --type ]] && type="$2"; shift; done
+    cat "$BR_FIX/list-$type.json" ;;
+  *) exit 0 ;;
+esac
+STUB
+    chmod +x "$WORK/bin/br"
+    export PATH="$WORK/bin:$PATH"
+    cd "$WORK/cwd"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    cd /
+    rm -rf "$WORK"
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# golden-path-charting.bats: the `charting` planning phase and the multi-map rule in
+# .claude/scripts/golden-path.sh (SDD D-4.5, D-4.6). Detection reads only the map doc's
+# **Status**: line, so it works without br. Hermetic: golden-path.sh and its two sourced
+# libraries are copied into a temp project (the shape of tests/integration/test_golden_path.bats).
+
+setup() {
+    TEST_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
+    export PROJECT_ROOT="$TEST_DIR"
+    export CONFIG_FILE="$TEST_DIR/.loa.config.yaml"
+    export LOA_USE_LEGACY_PATHS=1
+    unset LOA_UNATTENDED LOA_FLATLINE_MODE
+    REAL="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+    mkdir -p "$TEST_DIR/.claude/scripts" "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/a2a" "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/maps" "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/context"
+    for f in bootstrap.sh path-lib.sh compat-lib.sh golden-path.sh; do cp "$REAL/.claude/scripts/$f" "$TEST_DIR/.claude/scripts/"; done
+    (cd "$TEST_DIR" && git init -q 2>/dev/null)
+    cd "$TEST_DIR"
+    source "$TEST_DIR/.claude/scripts/golden-path.sh"
+}
+
+teardown() { cd /; rm -rf "$TEST_DIR"; }
+
+map() { # slug status
+    printf '# Map: %s\n\n**Slug**: %s\n**Status**: %s\n**Epic**: bd-%s\n\n## Destination\nx\n\n## Decisions so far\n\n## Not yet specified\n\n## Out of scope\n' \
+        "$1" "$1" "$2" "$1" > "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/maps/$1.md"
+}
+tree() { (cd "$TEST_DIR" && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -print | LC_ALL=C sort); }
+
+@test "GPC-1 a charting map with no PRD reports the charting phase" {
+    map eval-workers charting
+    [ "$(golden_detect_plan_phase)" = "charting" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-2 no map: discovery, as before" {
+    [ "$(golden_detect_plan_phase)" = "discovery" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-3 a handed-off, closed or abandoned map: discovery again" {
+    for st in handed-off closed abandoned; do
+        map eval-workers "$st"
+        [ "$(golden_detect_plan_phase)" = "discovery" ]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "GPC-4 the README in maps/ is not a map" {
+    printf '# Decision maps\n\n**Status**: charting\n' > "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/maps/README.md"
+    [ "$(golden_detect_plan_phase)" = "discovery" ]
+    [ -z "$(golden_open_maps)" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-5 a PRD wins over an open map: architecture" {
+    map eval-workers charting
+    touch "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/prd.md"
+    [ "$(golden_detect_plan_phase)" = "architecture" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-6 detection works with no br on PATH and exits 0" {
+    map eval-workers charting
+    stub="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/nobr"; mkdir -p "$stub"
+    printf '#!/bin/sh\necho "br: not installed" >&2\nexit 127\n' > "$stub/br"; chmod +x "$stub/br"
+    PATH="$stub:$PATH" run golden_detect_plan_phase
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$output" = "charting" ]
+    map eval-workers closed
+    PATH="$stub:$PATH" run golden_detect_plan_phase
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$output" = "discovery" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-7 consumers: workflow state initial, the menu offers Continue charting, plan routes to /chart <slug>" {
+    map eval-workers charting
+    [ "$(golden_detect_workflow_state)" = "initial" ]
+    menu="$(golden_menu_options)"
+    grep -q '^Continue charting|' <<< "$menu"
+    [ "$(golden_resolve_truename plan)" = "/chart eval-workers" ]
+    [ "$(golden_suggest_command)" = "/plan" ]
+    map other-map charting
+    [ "$(golden_resolve_truename plan)" = "/chart" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-8 no charting map: no Continue charting entry, plan routes to /plan-and-analyze" {
+    map eval-workers handed-off
+    menu="$(golden_menu_options)"
+    [[ "$menu" == *"Plan a new project|"* ]]
+    ! grep -q '^Continue charting|' <<< "$menu"
+    [ "$(golden_resolve_truename plan)" = "/plan-and-analyze" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-9 multi-map helper: none, one, a named one, an unknown name" {
+    run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ -z "$output" ]
+    map eval-workers charting
+    map old-map abandoned
+    run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "eval-workers" ]
+    map second handed-off
+    run golden_resolve_open_map second
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "second" ]
+    run golden_resolve_open_map old-map
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-10 several open maps, interactive: exit 3 with every slug for the operator to choose" {
+    map eval-workers charting
+    map second handed-off
+    run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
+    [ "$output" = "$(printf 'eval-workers\nsecond')" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-11 several open maps, unattended: exit 1 'more than one open map: name one', nothing written" {
+    map eval-workers charting
+    map second charting
+    before="$(tree)"
+    LOA_UNATTENDED=1 run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"more than one open map: name one"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"eval-workers"* && "$output" == *"second"* ]]
+    [ "$(tree)" = "$before" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-12 two chart-*.md hand-off snapshots, unattended: exit 1, nothing written" {
+    printf '# Priority-1 context\n' > "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/context/chart-eval-workers.md"
+    printf '# Priority-1 context\n' > "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/context/chart-second.md"
+    before="$(tree)"
+    LOA_UNATTENDED=1 run golden_resolve_open_map --snapshots
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"more than one open map: name one"* ]]
+    [ "$(tree)" = "$before" ]
+    run golden_resolve_open_map --snapshots
+    [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
+    rm "$TEST_DIR/grimoires/loa/context/chart-second.md"
+    run golden_resolve_open_map --snapshots
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "eval-workers" ]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-13 with the ledger writer installed, its unattended verdict drives the rule" {
+    mkdir -p "$TEST_DIR/.claude/scripts/lib"
+    cp "$REAL/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh" "$TEST_DIR/.claude/scripts/lib/"
+    source "$TEST_DIR/.claude/scripts/golden-path.sh"
+    map eval-workers charting
+    map second charting
+    run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
+    LOA_UNATTENDED=1 run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    mkdir -p "$TEST_DIR/.run"
+    printf '{"state":"RUNNING"}\n' > "$TEST_DIR/.run/state.json"
+    run golden_resolve_open_map
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"more than one open map: name one"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "GPC-14 golden-path.sh still never reads run state for position" {

new file mode 100644
index 00000000..1faae6f7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/spike-validator.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,269 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/spike-validator.bats: the spike discipline (grimoires/loa/sdd.md
+# D-5.4, D-5.5, D-5.9).
+#
+#   validate-artifact.sh --type spike: the template passes; an empty Verdict,
+#   a missing section, a Pointer without a branch or path, a Decided by naming
+#   neither operator nor agent, a non-spike Branch header and a URL fail.
+#   block-destructive-bash.sh: SP-1 cases that need a git checkout (gh pr
+#   create with no head on a spike branch), and the spike-delete predicate:
+#   force-deleting spike/<slug> passes only with a decided verdict row.
+# The command-string shapes of SP-1 live in the fence corpus
+# (tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl, rows B50-B59 and D61-D72).
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+    TEMPLATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md"
+    HOOK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
+    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
+    export LOA_REPO_ROOT="$WORK/audit"
+    mkdir -p "$LOA_REPO_ROOT"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    cd /
+    rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# A filled-in report.
+spike_report() {
+    cat <<'EOF'
+# Spike: ceiling-ui
+
+**Bead**: bd-p1
+**Branch**: spike/ceiling-ui
+**Date**: 2026-10-14
+
+## Question
+Does the ceiling table read better as a chart?
+
+## What was built
+A static page rendering both forms from one fixture.
+
+## Verdict
+The chart, with the table behind a toggle.
+
+## Pointer
+Branch spike/ceiling-ui at commit 1a2b3c4.
+
+## Decided by
+operator, recorded as DEC-0042.
+EOF
+}
+
+# Replace the body of section $1 in stdin with $2 (empty: drop the body).
+with_section() {
+    awk -v want="## $1" -v repl="$2" '
+        $0 == want { print; if (repl != "") print repl; skip = 1; next }
+        skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+        !skip { print }
+    '
+}
+
+hook_in() {
+    local dir="$1" cmd="$2"
+    (cd "$dir" && jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}' | bash "$HOOK")
+}
+
+# --- validate-artifact.sh --type spike ------------------------------------------
+
+@test "spike: the shipped template passes" {
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$TEMPLATE"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a filled-in report passes without warnings" {
+    spike_report > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: an empty Verdict fails (template and report)" {
+    with_section "Verdict" "" < "$TEMPLATE" > "$WORK/t.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/t.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" "" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: each missing section is named" {
+    local s
+    for s in "Question" "What was built" "Verdict" "Pointer" "Decided by"; do
+        spike_report | grep -vxF "## $s" > "$WORK/r.md"
+        run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+        [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+        [[ "$output" == *"missing section '## $s'"* ]]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "spike: a Pointer naming neither a spike branch nor a path fails; a path passes" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "the prototype we looked at" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Pointer' names neither"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "prototypes/ceiling/index.html" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: Decided by must name operator or agent; a missing DEC id WARNs" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "the team, DEC-0042" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"names neither operator nor agent"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "agent" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Decided by' cites no DEC row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a Branch header that is not spike/<slug> fails; a multi-line Verdict WARNs" {
+    spike_report | sed 's#^\*\*Branch\*\*: spike/ceiling-ui#**Branch**: feature/ceiling-ui#' > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"is not a spike/<slug> branch"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" $'The chart.\nAlso the table.' > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Verdict' has 2 lines"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a URL fails (plain prose)" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "spike/ceiling-ui, demo at https://example.invalid/demo" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"a URL in the document"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a report validated on a spike checkout WARNs that it belongs on the working branch" {
+    git init -q "$WORK/repo"
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    spike_report > "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: this checkout is on spike/ceiling-ui"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- SP-1 cases that need a git checkout ------------------------------------------
+
+spike_repo() {
+    REPO="$WORK/repo"
+    git init -q "$REPO"
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.email t@t
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.name t
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    BASE="$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m "prototype"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: gh pr create with no head is blocked on a spike branch and allowed on the working branch" {
+    spike_repo
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q spike/ceiling-ui
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    # an explicit non-spike head is the operator's statement: not judged by branch
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --head feature/x --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: the block message names the allowed forms and the working-branch rule" {
+    run hook_in "$WORK" "git merge spike/ceiling-ui"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"git push -u origin spike/<slug>"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"on the working branch"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- the spike-delete predicate (D-5.9) -------------------------------------------
+
+skip_without_yq4() {
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+    yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.' || skip "needs mikefarah yq v4"
+}
+
+# write_ledger <status> <source> <by-of-the-decided-step>
+write_ledger() {
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    cat > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" <<EOF
+schema_version: 1
+decisions:
+  - id: "DEC-0042"
+    status: "$1"
+    source: "$2"
+    transitions:
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z", from: null, to: open, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T01:00:00Z", from: open, to: proposed, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T02:00:00Z", from: proposed, to: decided, by: "$3"}
+EOF
+}
+
+force_delete() {
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "git branch -D $*"
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: force-deleting an unmerged spike branch is blocked without a ledger row" {
+    spike_repo
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [FR-1.1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"whose verdict row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a decided verdict row (operator step) for the spike's report allows the delete" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md#verdict" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a proposed row, an agent decided step, or another spike's row keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger proposed "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "agent:chart"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/other.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: every name must qualify; an unmerged non-spike branch beside a decided spike keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b feature/wip
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m wip
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui feature/wip
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    printf 'decisions: [unclosed\n' > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
diff --git a/tests/unit/unattended-prototype.bats b/tests/unit/unattended-prototype.bats

@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/unattended-prototype.bats: the prototype route in the planning
+# interview (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-5.1, D-5.7, D-5.8).
+#
+# The behaviour itself is skill prose; these checks pin what is checkable:
+# the config example documents interview.unattended_prototype with both values
+# and the default, each planning skill carries the interview rule in at most
+# two lines, and the sequencing guidance points at prototype tickets.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    CONFIG="$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml.example"
+    SKILLS="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills"
+}
+
+# The interview block's unattended_prototype comment and key, as text.
+prototype_block() {
+    awk '/^interview:/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { on = 0 } on' "$CONFIG" \
+        | awk '/Prototype-class questions/ { on = 1 } on { print } on && /^  unattended_prototype:/ { exit }'
+}
+
+@test "config example: interview.unattended_prototype defaults to defer" {
+    if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.'; then
+        [ "$(yq '.interview.unattended_prototype' "$CONFIG")" = "defer" ]
+    fi
+    grep -qE '^  unattended_prototype: defer[[:space:]]+# defer \| halt$' "$CONFIG"
+}
+
+@test "config example: both values are documented with their semantics" {
+    local block; block="$(prototype_block)"
+    [[ -n "$block" ]]
+    # defer: the bead, the open row, the PRD Deferred line, and planning continues
+    [[ "$block" == *"defer (default)"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"decision:prototype bead"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"open DEC row"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"**Deferred:** pending prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"continue planning"* ]]
+    # halt: the same bead and row, then planning stops with the documented message
+    [[ "$block" == *"halt: create the same bead and row, then stop planning"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"planning halted: prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "config example: the Deferred line it documents is the form the PRD validator recognises" {
+    grep -q 'the form is \*\*Deferred:\*\* pending prototype <bead> (DEC-NNNN)' \
+        "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+}
+
+@test "planning skills: each carries the prototype interview rule on at most two lines" {
+    local s f n
+    for s in discovering-requirements designing-architecture planning-sprints; do
+        f="$SKILLS/$s/SKILL.md"
+        n="$(grep -c 'I need to see it' "$f")"
+        [ "$n" -eq 1 ]
+        # the whole rule (through the config key) fits in the matching line and the next
+        grep -A1 'I need to see it' "$f" | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -q 'decision:prototype.*never an `\[ASSUMPTION\]`.*interview.unattended_prototype'
+    done
+}
+
+@test "planning-sprints REFERENCE: High-Risk Early points at prototype tickets, not spike tasks in build sprints" {
+    local ref="$SKILLS/planning-sprints/resources/REFERENCE.md" block
+    block="$(awk '/\*\*High-Risk Early\*\*/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[0-9]+\. \*\*/ { exit } on' "$ref")"
+    [[ "$block" == *"decision:prototype"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"not a spike task inside a build sprint"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" != *"Technical spikes"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "planning-sprints: the integration-context list moved to REFERENCE.md behind a pointer" {
+    grep -q '§Integration Context' "$SKILLS/planning-sprints/SKILL.md"
+    grep -q '^## Integration Context$' "$SKILLS/planning-sprints/resources/REFERENCE.md"
+}

== op_context
op_context(){
  PRD_PATH="$(o prd)"
  if has set-unattended; then
    local reason; reason="$(san1 "$(o reason)")"; [[ -n "$reason" ]] || usage "context --set-unattended needs --reason"
    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "context: jq is required"
    mkdir -p "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"
    local m="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/unattended.json" t
    t="$(mktemp "${m}.XXXXXX")"
    jq -n --arg r "$reason" --arg s "$(session_id)" --arg c "$(now_utc)" '{reason: $r, session_id: $s, created_at: $c}' > "$t"
    mv -f "$t" "$m"
    log "dec-write: unattended marker written (${m#"${PROJECT_ROOT}/"}); it expires after $(ttl_hours) h or when the session changes"
    echo unattended; return 0
  fi
  if has clear; then
    is_operator_call || die "context --clear runs only from the operator-only /decisions command (--recorded-by ${OPERATOR_CMD})"
    local mk="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/unattended.json"
    rm -f -- "$mk"
    log "dec-write: unattended marker cleared"
  fi
  # The verdict follows live signals only (chart-guard.sh, chart-ticket.sh and golden-path.sh read this
  # first line); the PRD Status line is listed by --why as advisory.
  local sig; sig="$(ctx_signals)"
  if printf '%s\n' "$sig" | grep -q '^live '; then echo unattended; else echo interactive; fi
  if has why; then
    if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$sig" | sed 's/^/signal: /; s/^\(signal: prd .*\)$/\1 (advisory: a planning-time default for new and decide only)/'; else echo "signal: none"; fi
    local d ms; while IFS= read -r d; do ms="$(marker_state "$d/unattended.json")"; if [[ "$ms" == "stale" ]]; then echo "note: stale marker ignored: $d/unattended.json"; fi; done < <(run_dirs)
  fi
  return 0
}

op_list(){
  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: jq is required"
  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: Mike Farah yq v4 is required"
  resolve_target read
  local fmt; fmt="$(o format)"; fmt="${fmt:-tsv}"
  [[ "$fmt" =~ ^(tsv|md|json)$ ]] || usage "--format must be tsv, md or json"
  local j
  if [[ ! -f "$TARGET" ]]; then j='{"schema_version":1,"decisions":[]}'; else
    j="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null)" || die "list: unparsable ledger ${TARGET}"
    printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '.schema_version == 1' >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "list: unknown schema_version in ${TARGET}"
    printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '(.decisions // []) | type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: no decisions sequence in ${TARGET}"
  fi
  local voice; voice="$(o voice)"; [[ -n "$voice" ]] || voice="$(o decided-by)"
  local ids; ids="$(om id | tr '\0' ',')"
  printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r --arg fmt "$fmt" --arg st "$(o status)" --arg vo "$voice" --arg nv "$(o not-decided-by)" \
    --arg cy "$(o cycle)" --arg since "$(o since)" --arg sp "$(o source-prefix)" --arg se "$(o source-epic)" --arg ids "$ids" '
    def csv: if . == "" then [] else split(",") | map(select(length > 0)) end;
    def cl: tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]]"; " ");
    def mc: cl | gsub("\\|"; "\\|");
    ($st | csv) as $S | ($vo | csv) as $V | ($nv | csv) as $NV | ($ids | csv) as $I
    | [ (.decisions // [])[]
        | (.decided_by // .proposed_by // "") as $voice | (.status // "") as $status | (.id // "") as $id
        | select(($S | length) == 0 or ($S | index($status)))
        | select(($V | length) == 0 or ($V | index($voice)))
        | select(($NV | length) == 0 or (($NV | index($voice)) | not))
        | select($cy == "" or .cycle == $cy)
        | select($since == "" or ((.created_at // "") >= $since))
        | select($sp == "" or ((.source // "") | startswith($sp)))
        | select($se == "" or ((.source // "") | startswith("map:" + $se + "/")))
        | select(($I | length) == 0 or ($I | index($id)))
        | . + {voice: $voice} ] as $rows
    | if $fmt == "json" then ($rows | tojson)
      elif $fmt == "tsv" then ($rows[] | [.id, .status, .voice, (.summary // ""), (.source // "")] | map(cl) | join("\t"))
      else
        if ($rows | length) == 0 then "_None: every decision in this run was the operator'"'"'s._"
        else ("| Decision | Voice | Status | Why | Source |", "|---|---|---|---|---|",
              ($rows[] | "| \((.summary // "") | mc) (\(.id)) | \(.voice | mc) | \(.status | mc) | \((.rationale // "") | mc) | \((.source // "") | mc) |"),
              "Confirm with /decisions confirm.")
        end
      end'

DISS-001 [BLOCKING/data-loss] .claude/scripts/chart-unblock-probe.sh:main-tree verification line=71 voice=gpt-5.5-pro
  DESC: The main-tree protection compares only git status entries, which do not capture file contents. If a tracked file is already modified before the probe, the probe can overwrite it and leave exactly the same status entry. The helper then exits successfully despite changing the main tree.
  FAIL: A probe overwrites existing uncommitted work in an already-dirty file; the before/after status strings remain identical, so the ticket incorrectly passes and the overwritten contents are lost.
  FIX: Fingerprint file contents before and after the probe, including existing dirty and untracked files, and fail when any fingerprint changes. Include ignored contents covered by the unchanged-tree guarantee.

DISS-C-001 [BLOCKING/authz] .claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:op_research_end line=451-471 voice=claude-headless
  DESC: The scope check compares two `git status --porcelain` listings and flags only lines that are new in the second listing (comm -13). A file whose status line is identical before and after is invisible: any tracked file already ` M` at dispatch time, or any untracked file already `??`, can be overwritten by the researcher without producing a new line. At the moment research-begin runs, `grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml` and `grimoires/loa/maps/<slug>.md` are almost always dirty, because op_ticket just wrote the open ledger row and the session is editing the map doc. A prompt-injected researcher (the agent file explicitly anticipates instruction-like text in fetched pages) can therefore append a `decided`/`operator:*` row to the ledger or rewrite the map doc, and research-end reports success. The awk filter also whitelists the whole `grimoires/loa/research/` directory, so overwriting other tickets' reports (which op_handoff later inlines) is likewise allowed. The `-newer` mtime check that would catch these is applied only to `.run` and `.beads`.
  FAIL: Untrusted web content steers the researcher into writing the decision ledger or map doc; the scope check passes; the forged row is later treated as settled context by /plan-and-analyze and can unlock the FR-1.1 spike-branch deletion path in block-destructive-bash.sh.
  FIX: Snapshot content, not status lines: in research-begin record `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` plus a content hash of the working tree (e.g. `git add -A --intent-to-add` is too invasive; instead hash `git ls-files -mo --exclude-standard -z | xargs -0 sha256sum`, or compare `git diff | sha256sum` and `git diff --cached | sha256sum`), and in research-end also run `find "$ROOT" -type f -newer "$m" -not -path '*/.git/*'` over the whole tree, excluding only the single expected report path (not the whole research/ directory). Fail if anything else changed.

DISS-C-002 [ADVISORY/data-loss] .claude/scripts/chart-unblock-probe.sh:after line=71-76 voice=claude-headless
  DESC: The probe's main-tree verdict has the same blind spot as DISS-001: it compares two porcelain listings as whole strings, so a probe that rewrites a file that was already modified or already untracked before the run is not detected. In addition, the throwaway worktree shares the main repo's object store and refs, so a probe can `git branch -f`, `git tag`, `git update-ref`, `git stash` or `git push` against the main repository without `git status` of the main tree changing at all. The header promises 'exits 1 when the main tree's status changed', which is narrower than 'never writes App-Zone code in the main tree'.
  FAIL: An unblock probe silently alters already-dirty files or moves branch refs in the main repository and the helper exits 0, so the ticket records a clean probe.
  FIX: Record and compare `git for-each-ref` output and a content hash of modified/untracked files alongside the porcelain listing; document the shared-refs limitation in the header if it is accepted.

DISS-C-003 [ADVISORY/data-loss] .claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:_fr11_spike_decided line=642-657 voice=claude-headless
  DESC: The new exemption lets `git branch -D spike/<slug>` through solely because a tracked YAML file says the verdict is decided. It never checks that the spike was actually pushed (SP-1 describes the spike as 'pushed as the pointer for a decision'), so a spike whose push failed or was never run is deleted along with the only copy of the prototype the DEC row points at. The gate also trusts `by: operator:*` text in a file the agent can edit with any text tool, so the ledger becomes a writable bypass of a hook whose job is to catch exactly that class of mistake.
  FAIL: Operator decides the verdict, agent runs `git branch -D spike/x` before pushing (or after a rejected push); the hook allows it and the prototype commits become unreachable.
  FIX: Additionally require `git rev-parse -q --verify refs/remotes/origin/spike/<slug>` to exist and to equal (or contain) the local branch tip before returning 0; keep the block otherwise.

DISS-C-004 [ADVISORY/type-error] .claude/scripts/chart-frontier.sh:FILTER line=58-59 voice=claude-headless
  DESC: create-sprint-task.sh (same diff) documents that older br releases emit labels as `{name}` objects and handles both shapes. chart-frontier.sh's label filter does `tostring` on each label and checks `startswith("decision:")`; for an object label that yields the JSON text `{"name":...}`, which never starts with `decision:`, so every ticket fails the exactly-one-label test and the frontier is silently empty (exit 0, no output). The two scripts also disagree on the type field (`.issue_type // .type` here, `.issue_type` only in get-ready-work.sh).
  FAIL: On a br version that emits object labels, `/chart <slug>` reports an empty frontier for a map that has open tickets, and the session may wrongly conclude it should hand off or close the map.
  FIX: Normalise labels the same way as create-sprint-task.sh: `[(.labels // [])[] | if type == "object" then (.name // "") else tostring end]` before the `startswith` test, and share the type accessor between the two scripts.

content.content:
== run_with_timeout
#
# Exit codes:
#   Command's exit code on normal completion
#   124 on timeout (matches GNU timeout convention)
#
# Usage:
#   run_with_timeout 30 grep -rn "pattern" ./src
#   run_with_timeout 5 git ls-remote "$url" HEAD
#
run_with_timeout() {
  local timeout_val="$1"
  shift

  # Runtime detection (not cached) to support test PATH manipulation
  if command -v timeout &>/dev/null; then
    timeout "$timeout_val" "$@"
  elif command -v gtimeout &>/dev/null; then
    gtimeout "$timeout_val" "$@"
  elif command -v perl &>/dev/null; then
    # fork+exec pattern preserves $SIG{ALRM} handler in the parent.
    # bare exec would replace the process image, losing the handler.
    # IMPORTANT: Extract timeout and fork BEFORE setting alarm —
    # if alarm fires before fork returns, $pid is undef and
    # kill(9, undef) sends SIGKILL to process group 0.
    perl -e '
      my $timeout = shift @ARGV;
      my $pid = fork();
      die "fork failed: $!" unless defined $pid;
      if ($pid == 0) { exec @ARGV; die "exec failed: $!" }
      $SIG{ALRM} = sub { kill 9, $pid; exit 124 };
      alarm($timeout);
      waitpid($pid, 0);
      alarm(0);
      exit($? >> 8);
    ' "$timeout_val" "$@"
  else
    echo "WARNING: No timeout mechanism available, running without timeout" >&2
    "$@"
  fi
}

== sanitize_for_session_start
#   $1 - source: one of {L6, L7} (handoff body | SOUL.md content)
#   $2 - either inline content string OR an existing file path
# Options:
#   --max-chars N   Length cap (defaults: L7=2000, L6=4000 per SDD §1.4.1)
# Output:
#   Sanitized text on stdout; emits BLOCKER:... lines on stderr for
#   tool-call-pattern matches.
# Exit:
#   0 on success (with or without redactions)
#   2 on invalid arguments (unknown source, missing args)
# =============================================================================
sanitize_for_session_start() {
    local source="${1:-}"
    local content_or_path="${2:-}"
    shift 2 2>/dev/null || true

    # Default caps per SDD §1.4.1.
    local max_chars=4000
    case "$source" in
        L6) max_chars=4000 ;;
        L7) max_chars=2000 ;;
        "") echo "sanitize_for_session_start: missing <source>" >&2; return 2 ;;
        *)  echo "sanitize_for_session_start: unknown source '$source' (expected L6|L7)" >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac

    # Optional --max-chars override.
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        case "$1" in
            --max-chars)
                max_chars="$2"
                shift 2
                ;;
            *)
                echo "sanitize_for_session_start: unknown flag '$1'" >&2
                return 2
                ;;

# Sprint 1 Review Feedback

**Reviewer:** Senior Tech Lead Reviewer Agent
**Date:** 2026-10-20
**Sprint Reference:** grimoires/loa/sprint.md
**Implementation Report:** grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/reviewer.md (PR.md: "feat(cycle-128): sprint-253 decision surfaces, part 2 — the /chart decision map and the prototype-ticket discipline", 41 files)

---

## Overall Assessment

The change is well-structured: the `/chart` shell steps are split into small idempotent subcommands with a ledger-row-first write order, the map validator enforces an H2 allowlist so a map doc cannot carry execution text, the SP-1 fence rows all behave as declared, and the test coverage is broad (eleven suites, 22 new corpus rows). The dissent ran with two voices (gpt-5.5-pro via codex-headless, claude-headless companion) and produced five findings; two of its blocking findings are confirmed below.

Three defects block the merge. Two are in safety gates that the PR itself describes as fail-closed and that reproduce as fail-open: the spike-branch delete exemption in `block-destructive-bash.sh` lets `git branch -D spike/<slug>` through when the decision ledger cannot be parsed, and the research-subagent scope check in `chart-ticket.sh` cannot see writes into already-dirty files or into directory-level-ignored paths such as `grimoires/loa/context/` (the hand-off directory `/plan-and-analyze` reads as priority-1 context). The third is a documented refusal that does not happen: `chart-guard.sh` does not refuse a PRD whose Status says autonomous, and the PR's own CD-10 test fails on it.

The implementation report carries no `## AC Verification` walkthrough; the only report is the PR title and file count.

**Test evidence.** Suites run in a merged head tree (the workspace checkout drops exec bits and `/tmp` is noexec, so the tree was rebuilt under `$HOME` with modes restored): chart-frontier 12/12, charting-decisions 28/29 (CD-10 fails), charting-lint 22/22, golden-path-charting 14/14, unattended-prototype 6/6, run-mode-ice 50/50, agents-md-gen 8/8, spike-validator 13/16 (one real failure: "an unparsable ledger keeps the block"; two need `grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md`, absent from this checkout), validate-artifact 48/60 (all nine new `map` tests pass; the twelve failures need the live ledger, absent here), skill-capabilities 33/36 (three failures are pre-existing lines using a `tostring` jq expression this yq 4.40.5 rejects). Fence corpus rows B50-B59 and D61-D72: 22/22 as declared. `validate-skill-capabilities.sh --skill charting-decisions`: PASS.

**Verdict:** CHANGES REQUIRED

---

## Changes Required

### 1. Security: the spike-delete exemption fails open on an unparsable ledger

- **HIGH** (confidence: high) `.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:651-656` — `_fr11_spike_decided` pipes `yq` into `jq -e` with no `pipefail` (the hook forbids it, line 14). When `yq` cannot parse `grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml` it prints nothing, `jq -e` on empty input exits 0 on jq 1.6, the predicate returns 0, and `git branch -D spike/<slug>` on an unmerged spike is allowed.
**File:** `head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:651-656`
**Issue:** Reproduced in a scratch repo with a spike branch holding an unmerged commit: with `decisions: [unclosed` as the ledger the hook exits 0 (allowed); with no ledger it exits 2 (blocked). The PR's own test `D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block` (`head/tests/unit/spike-validator.bats:268`) fails here for the same reason. The comment above the function promises "any failed lookup keeps the block".
**Why This Matters:** A safety hook whose outcome depends on the installed jq version is not fail-closed. A corrupted or half-written ledger (the writer swaps files atomically, but a hand edit or merge conflict marker does not) unlocks deletion of the only copy of a prototype the DEC row points at.
**Required Fix:** Capture the yq output first and refuse on failure or empty output, then require a literal `true`:
```bash
local j; j=$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$ledger" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
[[ -n "$j" ]] || return 1
[[ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '...' 2>/dev/null)" == "true" ]]
```
Keep the bats case; it is the right regression test and must pass on jq 1.6 and 1.7 alike.
**Reference:** CWE-636 (Not Failing Securely), CWE-754.

- **HIGH** (confidence: high) `.claude/scripts/chart-guard.sh:42` — the guard reads only the first line of `dec-write-lib.sh context`, which reports a PRD Status line as advisory and prints `interactive`; the header (line 8), `chart.md:80` and the SKILL promise a refusal in that case, and the PR's own CD-10 test fails.

**Issue:** Reproduced: with `**Status:** Draft, autonomous run` in `grimoires/loa/prd.md` and no other signal, `chart-guard.sh --root <fixture>` prints `interactive` and exits 0. `dec-write-lib.sh context --why` lists `signal: prd ... The same first-line read gates `close --reason` at `head/.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:407`.
**Why This Matters:** The PR ships a red test and a documented refusal that does not occur. Either the gate or the documentation is wrong; the merged state cannot pass CI.
**Required Fix:** Decide the contract. If the PRD line should refuse `/chart`, read `context --why` and treat a `signal: prd` line as unattended for this guard (and for `close --reason`). If it should not, remove the claim from `chart-guard.sh:8`, `chart.md:80` and drop or invert CD-10.
**Reference:** FAST-GATE: a failing test carries the weight of a test failure.

- **MEDIUM** (confidence: high) `.claude/scripts/chart-frontier.sh:59` — the exactly-one-`decision:` filter applies `tostring` to each label, so a `{name: "decision:grilling"}` label becomes JSON text and never matches; the frontier is silently empty (exit 0, no output).

**Suggestion:** Reproduced with the stub: a ticket with `labels: [{"name":"decision:grilling"}]` disappears. `create-sprint-task.sh:442-445` and `validate-artifact.sh` normalise both shapes; use the same `if type == "object" then (.name // "") else tostring end` here (dissent DISS-C-004).
